value.answer: Tomorrow in Toronto looks warm, around 25°C, with a mix of sun and cloud. There's a 40% chance of showers and a risk of a thunderstorm late in the afternoon. Tuesday night drops to a low of about 15°C. Going by Environment Canada's latest forecast. Some other forecasts put the showers earlier in the day, so the timing isn't settled.
